subject: Problem passing list of variables to choices in selectInput

messages.subject: Problem passing list of variables to choices in selectInput
parts:
I have a reactive that returns a list of variables by parsing the content of a textInput. The list of variables is then used in selectInput and/or updateSelectInput.

I can't make it work. Any suggestions?

I have made two attempts. The first approach is to use the reactive outVar() directly into selectInput. The second approach is to use the reactive outVar() in updateSelectInput. Neither works.

When I debug in the console, it appears that outVar() returns a list as desired. 

In the console, these two look the same:

selectInput(inputId = "inVar", label = h4("Select:"), choices =  outVar())

selectInput(inputId = "inVar", label = h4("Select:"), choices =  list("a","b"))

but the former fails, while the latter works.

    observe({

    output$inVar2 <- renderUI({

messages.subject: Re: Problem passing list of variables to choices in selectInput
parts:
The problem was that input$inBody does not retrieve a character even though the selectInput function is given a character as value, namely value = "a+b+c". The solution is therefore to wrap input$inBody in a as.character

None of this could be seen in the console where input$inBody appeared as "a+b+c" with or without as.character() around it.

The following works:

The observe approach with updateSelectInput:

observe({
     input$inBody
     text <- as.character(input$inBody)
     vars <- all.vars(parse(text=text))
     vars <- as.list(vars)
     updateSelectInput(session = session, inputId = "inVar", choices = vars)
})

The reactive approach with selectInput:

outVar <- reactive({
    vars <- all.vars(parse(text=as.character(input$inBody)), functions = FALSE, unique = TRUE)
    vars <- as.list(vars)
    return(vars)
})

output$inVar2 <- renderUI({
    selectInput(inputId = "inVar2", label = h4("2. Select a variable:"), choices =  outVar())
})
